newsitem.title: USA: Boy, 9, burns child with gas-soaked dog food in U.S..
newsitem.headline: Boy, 9, burns child with gas-soaked dog food in U.S..

text.p: A nine-year-old New Mexico boy will be charged with torching a seven-year-old boy after he threw gasoline-soaked dog food at him, police said on Monday.

Officer Brannon Porch, of the Bernalillo Police Department said the older child, whose name has not been released, faced charges of aggravated battery with great bodily harm after he set seven-year-old Andreas Fernandez alight last week at his home in Bernalillo, about 16 miles (26 km) north of Albuquerque.
"This is the first I've heard of anything like this, anywhere," said Porch.

Police said Andreas accidentally poured gasoline on himself and the nine-year-old then purposefully began soaking dried dog-food pellets in gasoline, lighting them, and throwing them at the younger child.
Andreas was hit by a pellet and went up in a ball of flames, police said. He is in serious condition in an Albuquerque hospital with second and third degree burns.
